Definition: Reference number as printed in the Literature Cited: integer, or integer plus an inserted-entry suffix (letter a-z as printed, e.g. 3625a; printed subscript digit written as _1, _2, e.g. 5424_1); the key cited at the end of every data line in the species accounts
Note: one row per individual number including suffixed inserts; unique, asserted; inserts may be printed before their base number (781a before 781); 1924a is printed out of sequence (between 1294 and 1295) and kept as printed

Definition: Integer part of ref_number
Note: bare numbers strictly increasing 1..12139, asserted; 1744, 5418, 11166 are absent from the printed book (verified on page images)

Definition: Insert suffix: '' for a bare number, 'a'-'z' as printed, '_<digit>' for a printed subscript digit, letter+'_1' for a subscript after a letter (5405b_1)
Note: subscript tokens were OCR'd as ',' or as a fused trailing digit and are recovered on the current base (see number_note)

Definition: Full bibliographic entry verbatim from the OCR text layer: the number token removed, line wraps joined (a line ending in a hyphen is joined without a space), whitespace collapsed; OCR errors retained (e.g. '.1 Mamm' for 'J Mamm', 'Omithorhynchus')
Note: authoritative column; 'not used' marks a number the book reserved without an entry

Definition: Surname block of the first author: text before the first comma of the author block; heuristic split of the verbatim citation
Note: author block = text before the first ' YYYY. ' token

Definition: Publication year token: four digits with optional letter or range (1972-74, 1968/69), the first such token followed by '.' or ',' after the author block; heuristic

Title: text between the year and the journal/book block; heuristic (for journal articles the block before 'Journal. VOL:PAGES'; for books the first sentence after the year; when the period between title and journal is lost the whole block is kept here, volume/pages taken and journal left NA -> partial)

Journal abbreviation as printed (BioSciences Information Service style, see _core_journals.csv) for journal articles; for books/chapters/reports the remainder after the title (book title, pages, editors, publisher, place)
Volume token before the colon, including issue in parentheses or supplement if printed
Page range after the colon, as printed
Printed page of the book on which the entry starts (705-990)
Note: running header checked against slice position

Definition: Page within pdf_by_order/..._21_LiteratureCited.pdf (1-286)
Page within the whole-book PDF (716-1001 = slice page + 715)

parsed = authors, year, title, journal, volume and pages all split; partial = year found but not the full journal pattern (books, chapters, reports, OCR-damaged journal lines); verbatim_only = no year token found (includes 'not used' placeholders)
How an OCR-damaged number token was resolved to ref_number (gap fill, digit-similar suffix, subscript insert), or 'printed not used'; NA when the token was read cleanly
Note: every corrected token is quoted verbatim

Definition: Number of OCR text lines joined into the citation
Column of the printed page in which the entry starts (L/R)
Core journal full name as printed in Appendix 2 (printed pp. 995-998)
Note: journals reviewed volume by volume 1964-1988 or vol. 1-1991

Definition: Abbreviation used in the bibliography, as printed in parentheses under the journal name
Note: other abbreviations follow the BioSciences Information Service (book statement)

Definition: Reference-number token found at the end of a species-account data line or in a parenthesised list, with no row in the references table
Note: plausibility check of the bibliography parse; tokens may be OCR noise or values misread as numbers

Definition: Base numbers in the page's header range with no row anywhere in the references table
Note: residual = 1744;5418;11166, printed gaps in the book

Definition: Bare numbers found on the page but outside its header range (asserted empty)
